WITH category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN spent <> 0 AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL
                THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount
            END) AS avg_relative_overspend,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
),
with_average AS (
    SELECT
        avg_relative_overspend,
        line_count,
        AVG(line_count) OVER () AS average_line_count
    FROM category_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS average_relative_overspend,
    AVG(line_count) AS average_line_count,
    AVG(line_count - average_line_count) AS average_excess_line_count
FROM with_average
WHERE line_count > average_line_count;
